version: LOCK 4 V1 (8 Nov 2026) - the market stall and your bag
builds_on: LOCK 1 V2, LOCK 2 V3, LOCK 3 V1. Placeholders: {n} number.

items.name: Bread
items.line: A round loaf, baked this morning.
items.use: Give it away at the quay.

items.name: Dates
items.line: A handful, wrapped in a leaf.

items.name: Local clothes
items.line: A robe and head cloth like everyone here wears.
items.use: Wear them and you stop looking like a foreigner.

stall.title: Rashid's stall
stall.intro: Rashid sells a little of everything beside his spice sacks. He holds up fingers for the price.

change.title: Your change
change.text: Rashid counts your change fast. When you look at your hand, there are {n} coins too many.
change.returned: Rashid laughs, surprised, and touches his heart. “Most people keep it.”
change.kept: You close your hand. Rashid has already turned to the next customer.
change.found: Rashid stops you. “I counted my box last night. Five coins short - and you were my only buyer.” He says nothing more.

feed: Faris takes the bread and runs to share it with the younger boys at the quay.

fed: Feeds the orphan at the quay
